scope: Prospective natural-workload pair only; separate source/protocol qualification required before collection. Not a new ten-hour, physical-EOS or MPC claim.
identity_scope: Legacy ModelParameters used ONLY for actuator identity; default serial service coefficients are never evaluated.
split_unit: Independent arrival/action seed block; cells and arms are correlated
contrasts: Whole assigned sequences, not same-state pointwise causal differences
assignment_order: Independent prespecified randomized arm order per block/cell
assignment_execution: Changed budgets require guarded applied ACK; unchanged budgets require a fresh same-version observation of the prior applied ACK
epoch_scope: Drained paired-episode rollover; retain the production 1024-operation idempotency ceiling; do not evict outcomes or restart native vLLM
observer_scope: Native observer samples; no CUDA timing or pristine-hook claim
